verses.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וַיִּמָּלֵ֖ט אֶל־ מְעָרַ֣ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶחָיו֙ וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יו וַיֵּרְד֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ miš·šām way·yim·mā·lêṭ ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ‘ă·ḏul·lām way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’e·ḥāw wə·ḵāl bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw way·yê·rə·ḏū ’ê·lāw šām·māh
verses.literal: So David left Gath and took refuge in the cave of Adullam When his brothers and the rest of his father’s household heard about it they went down to him there
verses.literalPt: Davi retirou-se dali e escapou para a cova de Adulão. O que tendo ouvido seus irmãos e toda a casa de seu pai, desceram para lá a ter com ele.

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצ֣וּ אֵ֠לָיו כָּל־ אִ֨ישׁ מָצ֜וֹק וְכָל־ אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֤וֹ נֹשֶׁא֙ וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ מַר־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ וַיְהִ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וַיִּהְי֣וּ עִמּ֔וֹ כְּאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū ’ê·lāw kāl- ’îš mā·ṣō·wq wə·ḵāl ’îš ’ă·šer- lōw nō·še wə·ḵāl ’îš mar- ne·p̄eš way·hî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·śār way·yih·yū ‘im·mōw kə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš
verses.literal: And all who were distressed or - indebted . . . . . . or discontented . . . rallied around him and he became their leader About four hundred men were with him
verses.literalPt: Ajuntaram-se a ele todos os que se viam oprimidos, todos os que se achavam endividados e todos os amargurados de espírito; e ele se fez chefe sobre eles. Eram com ele cerca de quatrocentos homens.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד מִשָּׁ֖ם מִצְפֵּ֣ה מוֹאָ֑ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֗ב יֵֽצֵא־ נָ֞א אָבִ֤י וְאִמִּי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵדַ֔ע מַה־ יַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לִּ֖י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ miš·šām miṣ·pêh mō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer ’el- me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ yê·ṣê- nā ’ā·ḇî wə·’im·mî ’it·tə·ḵem ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’ê·ḏa‘ mah- ya·‘ă·śeh- lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: From there David went to Mizpeh of Moab where he said to the king of Moab Please let my father and mother stay with you until I learn what God will do for me
verses.literalPt: Dali, passou Davi para Mispa de Moabe e disse ao rei de Moabe: Peço-te que meu pai e minha mãe fiquem convosco, até que eu saiba o que Deus há de fazer a meu respeito.

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֕ם אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ עִמּ֔וֹ כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י הֱיוֹת־ דָּוִ֖ד בַּמְּצוּדָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yan·ḥêm ’eṯ- pə·nê me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ way·yê·šə·ḇū ‘im·mōw kāl- yə·mê hĕ·yō·wṯ- dā·wiḏ bam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So he left them in the care of the king of Moab and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the stronghold
verses.literalPt: Trouxe-os perante o rei de Moabe; e com este ficaram por todo o tempo que Davi esteve no lugar seguro.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ גָּ֨ד הַנָּבִ֜יא אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד לֹ֤א תֵשֵׁב֙ בַּמְּצוּדָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ וּבָֽאתָ־ לְּךָ֖ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד וַיָּבֹ֖א יַ֥עַר חָֽרֶת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer gāḏ han·nā·ḇî ’el- dā·wiḏ lō ṯê·šêḇ bam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh lêḵ ū·ḇā·ṯā- lə·ḵā ’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yā·ḇō ya·‘ar ḥā·reṯ
verses.literal: Then the prophet Gad said to David Do not stay in the stronghold Depart and go into the land of Judah So David left and went to the forest of Hereth
verses.literalPt: Disse o profeta Gade a Davi: Não fiques no lugar seguro; sai e entra na terra de Judá. Saiu Davi e foi para o bosque de Herete.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל כִּ֚י נוֹדַ֣ע דָּוִ֔ד וַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וְשָׁאוּל֩ יוֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּגִּבְעָ֜ה תַּֽחַת־ הָאֶ֤שֶׁל בָּֽרָמָה֙ וַחֲנִית֣וֹ בְיָד֔וֹ וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו נִצָּבִ֥ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ šā·’ūl kî nō·w·ḏa‘ dā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw wə·šā·’ūl yō·wō·šêḇ bag·giḇ·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ- hā·’e·šel bā·rā·māh wa·ḥă·nî·ṯōw ḇə·yā·ḏōw wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Soon Saul learned that David . . . and his men . . . had been discovered At that time Saul was sitting under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah with his spear in hand and all his servants standing around him
verses.literalPt: Ouviu Saul que já se sabia de Davi e dos homens que estavam com ele. Ora, Saul estava sentado em Gibeá, debaixo da tamargueira em Ramá, tendo na mão a sua lança, e todos os seus servos o rodeavam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל לַֽעֲבָדָיו֙ הַנִּצָּבִ֣ים עָלָ֔יו שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י יְמִינִ֑י גַּם־ לְכֻלְּכֶ֗ם יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּן־ יִשַׁי֙ שָׂד֣וֹת וּכְרָמִ֔ים לְכֻלְּכֶ֣ם יָשִׂ֔ים שָׂרֵ֥י אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw šim·‘ū- nā bə·nê yə·mî·nî gam- lə·ḵul·lə·ḵem yit·tên ben- yi·šay śā·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḵə·rā·mîm lə·ḵul·lə·ḵem yā·śîm śā·rê ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·śā·rê mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Saul said to his servants . . . . . . Listen . . . men of Benjamin . . . Is the son of Jesse giving all of you fields and vineyards and making you commanders of thousands or hundreds
verses.literalPt: Disse aos seus servos que o rodeavam: Ouvi, agora, benjamitas! Acaso, o filho de Jessé vos dará a todos vós campos e vinhas e far-vos-á a todos capitães de milhares e capitães de centenas,

verses.original: כִּי֩ קְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם כֻּלְּכֶ֜ם עָלַ֗י וְאֵין־ גֹּלֶ֤ה אֶת־ אָזְנִי֙ בִּכְרָת־ בְּנִ֣י עִם־ בֶּן־ יִשַׁ֔י וְאֵין־ חֹלֶ֥ה מִכֶּ֛ם עָלַ֖י וְגֹלֶ֣ה אֶת־ אָזְנִ֑י כִּ֣י הֵקִים֩ בְּנִ֨י אֶת־ עַבְדִּ֥י עָלַ֛י לְאֹרֵ֖ב כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî qə·šar·tem kul·lə·ḵem ‘ā·lay wə·’ên- gō·leh ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nî biḵ·rāṯ- bə·nî ‘im- ben- yi·šay wə·’ên- ḥō·leh mik·kem ‘ā·lay wə·ḡō·leh ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nî kî hê·qîm bə·nî ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dî ‘ā·lay lə·’ō·rêḇ kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Is that why all of you have conspired against me Not one of you told me that my own son had made a covenant with the son of Jesse Not one of you has shown concern for me or revealed to me that my son has stirred up my own servant to lie in wait against me as is the case today . . .
verses.literalPt: para que todos vós tenhais conspirado contra mim e não haja ninguém que me dê aviso, ao entrar meu filho numa aliança com o filho de Jessé, e não haja ninguém que tenha pena de mim e me avise de ter meu filho sublevado contra mim ao meu servo, para que me arme ciladas, como hoje se vê?

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַן דֹּאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִ֗י וְה֛וּא נִצָּ֥ב עַל־ עַבְדֵֽי־ שָׁא֖וּל וַיֹּאמַ֑ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ בֶּן־ יִשַׁ֔י בָּ֣א נֹ֔בֶה אֶל־ אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֲחִטֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an dō·’êḡ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî wə·hū niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘aḇ·ḏê- šā·’ūl way·yō·mar rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- ben- yi·šay bā nō·ḇeh ’el- ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’ă·ḥi·ṭūḇ
verses.literal: But Doeg the Edomite who had stationed himself with Saul’s . . . servants answered I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub at Nob
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Doegue, idumeu, que estava ao lado dos servos de Saul: Eu vi o filho de Jessé vir a Nobe, a Aimeleque, filho de Aitube.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַל־ לוֹ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וְצֵידָ֖ה נָ֣תַן ל֑וֹ וְאֵ֗ת חֶ֛רֶב גָּלְיָ֥ת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י נָ֥תַן לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al- lōw Yah·weh wə·ṣê·ḏāh nā·ṯan lōw wə·’êṯ ḥe·reḇ gā·lə·yāṯ hap·pə·liš·tî nā·ṯan lōw
verses.literal: Ahimelech inquired of the LORD for him and gave him provisions He also gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine
verses.literalPt: Este consultou a Jeová a pedido dele, e lhe deu mantimento, e lhe deu também a espada de Golias, filisteu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ לִקְרֹא֩ אֶת־ אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֜וּב הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית אָבִ֛יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּנֹ֑ב וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ כֻלָּ֖ם אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ liq·rō ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ hak·kō·hên wə·’êṯ kāl- bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer bə·nōḇ way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḵul·lām ’el- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then the king sent messengers to summon Ahimelech the priest the son of Ahitub and his father’s whole family who were priests at Nob And all of them came to the king
verses.literalPt: Mandou o rei chamar ao sacerdote Aimeleque, filho de Aitube, e a toda a casa de seu pai, a saber, os sacerdotes que estavam em Nobe. Todos eles vieram à presença do rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֖א בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֑וּב וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנְנִ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl šə·ma‘- nā ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ way·yō·mer hin·nî ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Listen now son of Ahitub said Saul Here I am my lord he replied
verses.literalPt: Disse Saul: Ouve, filho de Aitube! Este respondeu: Eis-me aqui, meu senhor!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלוֹ שָׁא֔וּל לָ֚מָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּ֣ם עָלַ֔י אַתָּ֖ה וּבֶן־ יִשָׁ֑י בְּתִתְּךָ֨ ל֜וֹ לֶ֣חֶם וְחֶ֗רֶב וְשָׁא֥וֹל לוֹ֙ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים לָק֥וּם אֵלַ֛י לְאֹרֵ֖ב כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ʾē·lō šā·’ūl lām·māh qə·šar·tem ‘ā·lay ’at·tāh ū·ḇen- yi·šāy bə·ṯit·tə·ḵā lōw le·ḥem wə·ḥe·reḇ wə·šā·’ō·wl lōw bê·lō·hîm lā·qūm ’ê·lay lə·’ō·rêḇ kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: And Saul asked him Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired against me You gave him bread and a sword and inquired of God for him so that he could rise up against me to lie in wait as he is doing today . . .
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Saul: Por que conspirastes contra mim, tu e o filho de Jessé, em lhe dares tu pão e uma espada e em seu favor consultares a Deus, para que ele se sublevasse contra mim, armando-me ciladas, como hoje se vê?

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן אֲחִימֶ֛לֶךְ אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר וּמִ֤י בְכָל־ עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ כְּדָוִ֣ד נֶאֱמָ֔ן וַחֲתַ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְסָ֥ר אֶל־ מִשְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ךָ וְנִכְבָּ֥ד בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mar ū·mî ḇə·ḵāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā kə·ḏā·wiḏ ne·’ĕ·mān wa·ḥă·ṯan ham·me·leḵ wə·sār ’el- miš·ma‘·te·ḵā wə·niḵ·bāḏ bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Ahimelech answered the king . . . Who among all your servants is as faithful as David the king’s son-in-law the captain of your bodyguard and honored in your house
verses.literalPt: Aimeleque respondeu ao rei: Quem, entre todos os teus servos, é como Davi, fiel, genro do rei, chefe da tua guarda e honrado na tua casa?

verses.original: הַיּ֧וֹם הַחִלֹּ֛תִי לְשָׁאוֹל ל֥וֹ בֵאלֹהִ֖ים חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֑י אַל־ יָשֵׂם֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ בְּעַבְדּ֤וֹ דָבָר֙ בְּכָל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יָדַ֤ע עַבְדְּךָ֙ בְּכָל־ זֹ֔את דָּבָ֥ר קָטֹ֖ן א֥וֹ גָדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm ha·ḥil·lō·ṯî lə·šå̄·ʾōl lōw ḇê·lō·hîm ḥā·lî·lāh lî ’al- yā·śêm ham·me·leḵ bə·‘aḇ·dōw ḏā·ḇār bə·ḵāl bêṯ ’ā·ḇî kî lō- yā·ḏa‘ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā bə·ḵāl zōṯ dā·ḇār qā·ṭōn ’ōw ḡā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him Far be it from me Let not the king accuse . . . your servant or any of my father’s household for your servant knew nothing of this whole affair not in part or in whole
verses.literalPt: Porventura, é de hoje que comecei a consultar a Deus em seu favor? Longe de mim tal. Não impute o rei coisa alguma ao seu servo, nem a toda a casa de meu pai, pois o teu servo nada sabe de tudo isso, nem pouco nem muito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מ֥וֹת תָּמ֖וּת אֲחִימֶ֑לֶךְ אַתָּ֖ה וְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: But the king replied You will surely die . . . Ahimelech you and all your father’s house
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o rei: Vais morrer, Aimeleque, tu e toda a casa de teu pai.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ לָרָצִים֩ הַנִּצָּבִ֨ים עָלָ֜יו סֹ֥בּוּ וְהָמִ֣יתוּ׀ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י גַם־ יָדָם֙ עִם־ דָּוִ֔ד וְכִ֤י יָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־ בֹרֵ֣חַ ה֔וּא וְלֹ֥א גָל֖וּ אֶת־ אָזְנוֹ וְלֹֽא־ אָב֞וּ עַבְדֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣חַ אֶת־ יָדָ֔ם לִפְגֹ֖עַ בְּכֹהֲנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ lā·rā·ṣîm han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw sōb·bū wə·hā·mî·ṯū kō·hă·nê Yah·weh kî ḡam- yā·ḏām ‘im- dā·wiḏ wə·ḵî yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ḇō·rê·aḥ hū wə·lō ḡā·lū ’eṯ- ʾå̄·zə·nō wə·lō- ’ā·ḇū ‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ liš·lō·aḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏām lip̄·ḡō·a‘ bə·ḵō·hă·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the king ordered the guards at his side . . . Turn and kill the priests of the LORD because they too sided with David For they knew . . . he was fleeing but they did not tell me But the king’s servants would not lift a hand to strike the priests of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei aos da guarda que o rodeavam: Voltai-vos contra os sacerdotes de Jeová e matai-os, porque estão de mãos dadas com Davi, e porque sabiam que fugiu, e não me avisaram disso. Porém os servos do rei não quiseram estender as suas mãos para arremeter contra os sacerdotes de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְדוֹיֵג סֹ֣ב אַתָּ֔ה וּפְגַ֖ע בַּכֹּהֲנִ֑ים וַיִּסֹּ֞ב דּוֹיֵג הָאֲדֹמִ֗י וַיִּפְגַּע־ הוּא֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיָּ֣מֶת׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא שְׁמֹנִ֤ים וַחֲמִשָּׁה֙ אִ֔ישׁ נֹשֵׂ֖א אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ lə·ḏō·yēḡ sōḇ ’at·tāh ū·p̄ə·ḡa‘ bak·kō·hă·nîm way·yis·sōḇ dō·yēḡ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî way·yip̄·ga‘- hū bak·kō·hă·nîm way·yā·meṯ bay·yō·wm ha·hū šə·mō·nîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ’îš nō·śê ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ bāḏ
verses.literal: So the king ordered Doeg You turn and strike down the priests And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests himself On that day he killed eighty-five . . . men who wore the linen ephod
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei a Doegue: Vai tu e arremete contra os sacerdotes. Doegue, idumeu, voltou-se, arremeteu contra os sacerdotes e matou naquele dia oitenta e cinco homens que vestiam o éfode de linho.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת נֹ֤ב עִיר־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הִכָּ֣ה לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב מֵאִישׁ֙ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה מֵעוֹלֵ֖ל וְעַד־ יוֹנֵ֑ק וְשׁ֧וֹר וַחֲמ֛וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ nōḇ ‘îr- hak·kō·hă·nîm hik·kāh lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh mê·‘ō·w·lêl wə·‘aḏ- yō·w·nêq wə·šō·wr wa·ḥă·mō·wr wā·śeh lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He also put to the sword Nob the city of the priests with its men and women children and infants oxen donkeys and sheep . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A Nobe, cidade dos sacerdotes, passou ao fio da espada; passou ao fio da espada homens e mulheres, meninos e crianças de mama, e bois, jumentos e ovelhas,

verses.original: וַיִּמָּלֵ֣ט בֵּן־ אֶחָ֗ד לַאֲחִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־ אֲחִט֔וּב וּשְׁמ֖וֹ אֶבְיָתָ֑ר וַיִּבְרַ֖ח אַחֲרֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·lêṭ bên- ’e·ḥāḏ la·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’ă·ḥi·ṭūḇ ū·šə·mōw ’eḇ·yā·ṯār way·yiḇ·raḥ ’a·ḥă·rê ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: But one of the sons of Ahimelech son of Ahitub escaped His name was Abiathar and he fled to David
verses.literalPt: Um dos filhos de Aimeleque, filho de Aitube, que se chamava Abiatar, escapou e fugiu para Davi.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֥ד אֶבְיָתָ֖ר לְדָוִ֑ד כִּ֚י הָרַ֣ג שָׁא֔וּל אֵ֖ת כֹּהֲנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ ’eḇ·yā·ṯār lə·ḏā·wiḏ kî hā·raḡ šā·’ūl ’êṯ kō·hă·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Abiatar disse a Davi que Saul tinha feito morrer os sacerdotes de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לְאֶבְיָתָ֗ר יָדַ֜עְתִּי בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁם֙ דּוֹיֵג הָאֲדֹמִ֔י כִּֽי־ הַגֵּ֥ד יַגִּ֖יד לְשָׁא֑וּל אָנֹכִ֣י סַבֹּ֔תִי בְּכָל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ lə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār yā·ḏa‘·tî bay·yō·wm ha·hū kî- šām dō·yēḡ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî kî- hag·gêḏ yag·gîḏ lə·šā·’ūl ’ā·nō·ḵî sab·bō·ṯî bə·ḵāl ne·p̄eš bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: Then David said to Abiathar I knew that Doeg the Edomite . . . was there that day and that he was sure to tell . . . Saul I myself am responsible for the lives of everyone in your father’s house
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a Abiatar: Naquele dia em que Doegue, idumeu, se achou ali, eu bem sabia que ele o havia de dizer a Saul. Eu fui a causa da morte de todas as pessoas da casa de teu pai.

verses.original: שְׁבָ֤ה אִתִּי֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔א כִּ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת אַתָּ֖ה עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇāh ’it·tî ’al- tî·rā kî ’ă·šer- yə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- nap̄·šî yə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā kî- miš·me·reṯ ’at·tāh ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: Stay with me do not be afraid for he who seeks your life is seeking mine as well . . . You will be safe with me
verses.literalPt: Fica comigo, não temas, porque quem procura a minha vida procura também a tua; comigo estarás em segurança.
